Paid and incurred triangles of the Munich chain ladder paper

Source: R/reserving_data.R
quarg_mack.Rd

The cumulative paid and incurred claims of seven accident years with which Quarg and Mack (2004) introduce the Munich chain ladder.

Usage

quarg_mack_paid

quarg_mack_incurred

Format

Numeric matrices with 7 rows (accident years) and 7 columns (development years), NA for the future, with values in the same cells.

An object of class matrix (inherits from array) with 7 rows and 7 columns.

Source

Quarg, G. and Mack, T. (2004). Munich chain ladder. Blatter DGVFM 26(4), 597-630.

See also

munich_chain_ladder.

Examples

munich_chain_ladder(quarg_mack_paid, quarg_mack_incurred)$by_origin
